title: quizinfra quiz data — version 2
description: v1 plus the `tags` bag (string -> string map of arbitrary user metadata) and the `schemaVersion` stamp pinned to 2. TYPE-STRICT, PRESENCE-LENIENT policy (same as v1): every field may be absent — the import pipeline's normalize stage fills `tags` with the empty bag and every other gap with its documented default — but any field that IS present must match its declared type exactly. Arrays carry no cardinality constraint (the four-option editor layout is a UI policy, not a data-model one) and unknown properties are ignored (dropped at normalization). Self-contained by design: it does NOT $ref v1, so freezing v1 cannot be undone by editing v1 later.
